ns2:course.label: Medieval Architecture
ns2:course.description: Explores aspects of the architecture and urban design of medieval Europe from late antiquity to the late Middle Ages (approximately 300-1400). Same as MDVL 412. Prerequisite: ARCH 210 or ARTH 111.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as MDVL 412. Prerequisite: ARCH 210 or ARTH 111.
